failure_modes.cause: BPR set to 0 bar instead of recommended 1.1 bar
failure_modes.mitigation: Adjust BPR to 1.1 bar to ensure proper pressure maintenance

failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 60°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: High A/V ratio not sufficient for heat removal at target tau
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement additional cooling measures or reduce tau

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.85652 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR adjustment to 1.1 bar and observe system stability over 30 min
Conduct thermal imaging to assess heat distribution and removal efficiency
